cadaver-synod: In 897, a pope dug up his dead rival, dressed him in robes and put the corpse on trial.
pastry-war: In 1838, France sent warships to Mexico, and the bill it wanted paid started with a ruined pastry shop.
mummy-medicine: For hundreds of years, Europe's doctors told patients to eat ground-up Egyptian mummies.
king-midas: The golden-touch king was real: a Phrygian ruler whose family's tomb at Gordion held no gold at all.
